ready_open: Gateway is ready. Opening local browser: {url}
headless_skip_browser: No display: skipped opening a browser. Open the URL on this machine or another device.
phone_hint: On a phone or another PC, open the LAN / tunnel URL yourself (see below or the startup log). The installer does not open remote browsers.
failed_start: Start failed: could not reach {url} in time. Check data/runtime/console.log.
lang_saved: Installer language set to {lang} (saved in data/install_lang.txt)
install_body:
1. Extract this folder anywhere writable (avoid read-only Program Files if you want self-evolution writes).
2. Run Start (macOS: Start.command; Linux: Start.sh; Windows: Start.bat).
3. Your local browser opens http://127.0.0.1:PORT/ ; set API keys under Model settings.
4. On a phone, manually open the PC LAN IP:PORT (or tunnel URL) and enter the passcode from the startup log.
5. Switch launcher language: FAWAI_LANG=zh-CN or Start --lang zh-CN.
stop_hint: To stop: Ctrl+C in the Start terminal, or end the fawai-keeper process.
